book.name: Salmos
book.title: Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu

content: Yuwamand Apanll maachtawaa ichingaru tínarangu, anumand Apanllee yaseekaniya

content.text: Apanllimun mangini kis shambateeni.
Apaa, shiyamari taarashipantishcha.
Shiyaatsimari mangiptini kis shambatkiniya.
Shiyamari kasirush taaksha.
Shiyaatsimari ungirtakaniya, táchiniya.
Shaana 'sinee kamartapzish ashiru taaksha.
Kanindap íwar kawambananandari wayarangush,
Anumunsha, kungumun iwaz pangeemish wayarangitamsha.
Mishat, Apaa, shiy psaseem kinakataraa sheerush,
pshirshishushpaz ashirush psasish naaksha.
Kambusurpaz ashirush wizpurirpatish naaksha.
Kambusur watacha shiy tsiyatsipaneem k'kuz zanganikpaz ashiksha.
Shiy mamarootssha zangankush wizpureetsish tuyamandakiya.
Tsapurunaseetssha wanasir tinarangush, nda ayamamtiyam
piyam naata, piyamsha shpuzata nda ashishtamaam mbam wayarangsha.
Mar kung tsapurunasimun iwaz ashchiri kamispapaz ashiru purangsha.
Itaru, shiysha Apaa, kungoo kamachtarangush;
Tsapush naangcha, tárangush, kungsha k'keetsish kariyaatspaz ashiru mazinarangu,
mikeeru karuwataraa ashirangiya.
Machimun naanaataraa ashirangu, karuwataraa, yuwash shaana;
Neetsiri taangcha, tárangish, anush tsap watandsush kusarangu, zanayarangiya.
Nda piyam pseertaku anshuri wanasir wayarangsha.
Nda tsapoo yusur pumaam amb ashiru wayarangsha.
Shiy ichinguru zar kungoo wir zangankush,
zaw ashkachu, manginapsha naanaataraa ashkiya.
Zamizsha manginshuch anootssha kung waakanaya.
Burrutam kayustan waaksin, wasachee imayungakanaya.
Kpurangamash kungumun wing kachuteersin, ixateersin, ngichtayarusin, iparinakanaya.
Sheersin, mang' ksaksin yusakanaya.
Yasinamunaw piz waziweeru kis yusakanaya.
Apaa, shaana shiy sinapat maacheetsi kchitamaam istaksha.
Íwar taakush, anumandari shiy msasish kariytakchu,
sin sinakchu, anpasha tsapoo kachachtaksha.
Pastootssha wakaraam, zamzeem watungash wanasir chirichiree yanungaksha.
Mishat, chiy tputsich tatsumtarich, ansha tsapurunasish pzapaneechiya.
Yuw chiy tputsich katungkuch, wizpurireemich panaku kchitatarich,
misha kizarun wakunguree waakuch, mangich kis taatarich.
Mishat kizarun wakungur wayungunoo kasiru tsheetsich kapasarumcheekpaz ashkiya.
Libanush tsap shiy yasin washitanimash tatsumarangish,
anshat xixpurish kungoo waaktamsinaya.
Ashkusin, yasinsha kis taakanaya.
Anushsha yasin tsiripcheew pakcheew wipaam pzapanimaam ixatkanaya.
Mishat, karsa yasinash pinosh sura taakanaya.
Machish íwar kaaparaw kayustan kis taakanaya.
Mishat, patumbchish maachi pakchimash anshutam taakanaya.
Iyaam zareetstam, tsupeetstam táchimaam wayarangsha.
Zarsha waana puku anoo yasariya.
Zar pshtuyaru, tapeeramchu, anushsha manginshuch shitungartakanaya.
Manginshuch tumuz yusaku, Apanllee tsiyatku atanaya.
Zapan katungpani atusin, Apaa, Pananda, shiyaa atusin atanaya.
Itaru, zar sitataranllu, wapitam kanapkanaya.
Wachushtam pshtuyarusin, wantsush maakanaya.
Anushsha tputs tarawaztamaam shitungartakanaya.
Tapeekachsha tárawziree kasayarusin, kanuskanaya.
¿Wanip maacheetsi wanasir tinarangsha? Apaa.
Yuw ichinguru wayarangish an shaana wizpurirpatish, misha yasashpatish, tinarangsha.
Tsapurunasee tinarangish, anush tatsitarangsha.
Mishat, maree kung kapungu, waman, imur wayarangish an taariya.
Maachi zapan kapungumash, pakchimashtam anush taakana.
Táchimaam pinasa.
Anushsha marish bot naaktamanaya.
Misha, anshutam maachi kapungumash puraw kis taakiya.
Kis kungush michitku anootssha shiy kis napaksha.
Anshitisin, Apanll nuwaam katungsheemi panapanda, atusin,
Apaa, shiyaam kutakanaya.
Shiy shaana, Neewa, tákchush, anootssha katungkanaya.
Shiy kuwish paxayakpaz ashkush, anoo mang' ksakanaya.
Kapung tazaz taakanaya.
Itaru Apaa, shaana zandkush, wizpurireetsish kanasakchush,
uwshtisin kapung punikanaya.
Shiy taárashee kasakchush, tsipakanaya. Sheersin, wanuts tsapoomtam kinakanaya.
Itaru, Apaa, shiy wizpuririrpatish taárasheem tapus ashkachush, wipsha kis kanungartakanaya.
Ambi ashkush, tsapurunasee maachirit uru tanischichtar ashiksha, nuw shiyaa atina.
Ashiriya, Apanll wizpur ayamtaati pastacheeja; urutamari taachiya.
Apanll waanaa tinamarineetsi napku, mang' kis ashkiya.
Apanll wizpurpa tsapurunasee napkachu, tsapsha shpuzakiya.
Machee íwar patatkachu, machush psas tuwapeew shitungkiya.
Ashirucha, nuw ndatuma tsiparuri, kchitariti, Apanllireemi Taarashipaneem urutari yaseekuri taachima.
Ashiri yuw nuwaana chinaki anoo, shiysha, Apaa, nuwaa kis napanda, atina.
Watam nuw shiyamunari wizpurirish mangi kis taakina.
Yutaritshishpani waani tsipachpa; pastachpa.
Ayamamtiyam an ndusha taamaam izuuru pastachpa, Apaa, nuw shiyaa tina.
Itaru nuwsha shiyaa, Taarashipanee, mangipti kis ungirtachima.
Shiy kizpurtishcha.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Utaáshucheema 1.7 tayusima kamankiya.
